properties.formal_statement: For all light client updates u received from untrusted full nodes, if u.signature_slot <= u.current_slot and the update passes BLS aggregate signature verification, then u must have been signed by >= MIN_SYNC_COMMITTEE_PARTICIPANTS validators from the sync committee.
properties.natural_language: Light client updates from untrusted full nodes must carry valid sync committee signatures to prevent accepting forged updates.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - EXT-FULL-NODE-P2P is UNTRUSTED. This property prevents accepting forged updates from malicious full nodes.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Malicious full nodes could feed fraudulent chain state to light clients, causing them to accept invalid finalized headers and corrupted execution payload data.
attack_scenarios_mitigated: Malicious full node providing fake light client updates
Eclipse attack with coordinated malicious servers

properties.formal_statement: For all light client store states S and applied updates u, if S.finalized_header.slot = s_old and after applying u the new finalized_header.slot = s_new, then s_new >= s_old.
properties.natural_language: Light client finalized header slot numbers must be monotonically increasing or remain the same; they cannot decrease.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: HIGH - Ensures updates from UNTRUSTED sources cannot roll back finalized state.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: HIGH - Light client could be tricked into reverting to an older finalized state, enabling long-range attacks or re-org exploits.

properties.formal_statement: For all incoming updates u, u must satisfy: u.finalized_slot <= u.attested_slot < u.signature_slot <= current_slot, else u is rejected with STATE-VALIDATION-FAILED.
properties.natural_language: Light client update slot ordering must be strictly validated: finalized <= attested < signature <= current.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Rejects malformed updates from UNTRUSTED servers before cryptographic verification.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: MEDIUM - Could allow updates with impossible time ordering, though later checks might still reject them.

properties.formal_statement: For all updates u, if u passes ACTION-VERIFY-BLS-AGGREGATE, then the aggregate BLS signature over u.attested_header must verify against the sync committee public keys from the light client store.
properties.natural_language: BLS aggregate signature verification must succeed using the current sync committee before accepting any light client update.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Primary cryptographic defense against UNTRUSTED full nodes.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Complete compromise: attackers could forge updates without controlling sync committee validators.

properties.formal_statement: For all updates u, the number of sync committee participants (bits set in sync_aggregate.sync_committee_bits) must be >= MIN_SYNC_COMMITTEE_PARTICIPANTS (1), else u is rejected.
properties.natural_language: Light client updates must have at least one sync committee participant to be considered valid.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: MEDIUM - While MIN=1 is low, this prevents completely empty signatures from UNTRUSTED sources.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: LOW - Updates with zero participants would be nonsensical but later signature checks would fail anyway.

properties.formal_statement: For all updates u with finality_branch and next_sync_committee_branch, if ACTION-VERIFY-MERKLE-BRANCHES succeeds, then both branches must validate against u.attested_header.state_root using is_valid_normalized_merkle_branch().
properties.natural_language: Merkle branches for finalized header and next sync committee must cryptographically verify against the attested header state root.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Validates Merkle proofs from UNTRUSTED sources before accepting state commitments.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Attackers could claim arbitrary finalized headers or sync committees without valid state roots.

properties.formal_statement: For all updates u, u must not skip sync committee periods: compute_sync_committee_period_at_slot(u.attested_slot) must be current_period or current_period + 1 relative to the light client store.
properties.natural_language: Light client updates cannot skip sync committee periods; only current or next period updates are accepted.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: HIGH - Prevents UNTRUSTED servers from jumping light clients across sync committee rotations.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: HIGH - Light client could skip sync committees, missing rotation validation and enabling committee takeover attacks.

properties.formal_statement: If an honest full node provides a valid light client update u within the gossip window and the light client is connected to that node, then u will eventually transition through STATE-UPDATE-RECEIVED -> ACTION-VALIDATE-UPDATE -> STATE-UPDATE-VALID.
properties.natural_language: Valid light client updates from honest nodes will eventually be received and validated if network connectivity exists.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: MEDIUM - Assumes at least one honest node in the set of UNTRUSTED full nodes.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: MEDIUM - Light client could become stuck without finality progress, though not immediately vulnerable.
attack_scenarios_mitigated: Denial of service through update withholding (if multiple sources available)

properties.formal_statement: If no finality update advances the light client store within UPDATE_TIMEOUT (~27.3 hours), then ACTION-FORCE-UPDATE must execute to prevent liveness failure, promoting the best attested header to finalized.
properties.natural_language: After UPDATE_TIMEOUT without finality progress, light client must force-update to maintain liveness by promoting optimistic header.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: HIGH - Trades finality guarantee for liveness when UNTRUSTED servers withhold valid updates.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: HIGH (Liveness) - Light client would stall indefinitely during network partitions or coordinated censorship.

properties.formal_statement: The trusted block root provided via EXT-USER-TRUST-SOURCE for ACTION-BOOTSTRAP-STORE must correspond to a canonical chain block, as no cryptographic verification is possible for this root of trust.
properties.natural_language: The initial trusted block root obtained out-of-band MUST be correct, as it forms the unverifiable root of the entire light client trust chain.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - EXT-USER-TRUST-SOURCE is UNTRUSTED with no cryptographic authentication.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Complete compromise: light client bootstraps onto attacker-controlled fake chain.

properties.formal_statement: For optimistic header acceptance via ACTION-EVALUATE-OPTIMISTIC-SAFETY, participation must exceed safety_threshold = max_active_participants / 2. For finality via ACTION-EVALUATE-FINALITY, participation must exceed 2/3 of sync committee (supermajority).
properties.natural_language: Optimistic headers require > 50% max participation; finalized headers require > 2/3 supermajority of sync committee.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Primary defense against malicious sync committee members in UNTRUSTED updates.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Light client could accept headers signed by minority of sync committee, enabling committee takeover attacks.

properties.formal_statement: For all deposit logs extracted via ACTION-FILTER-DEPOSIT-LOGS, the log.address must equal the canonical deposit contract address (0x00000000219ab540356cbb839cbe05303d7705fa) and log.topics[0] must match the deposit event signature.
properties.natural_language: Only deposit logs from the canonical deposit contract with the correct event signature are extracted for consensus layer processing.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Filters logs from blocks provided via SEMI_TRUSTED CL-via-Engine-API (which relays from UNTRUSTED proposers).
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Malicious contracts could inject fake deposits by emitting events with matching signatures, corrupting the validator set.

properties.formal_statement: For all deposit event data parsed via ACTION-VALIDATE-LENGTH, len(deposit_event_data) must equal exactly 576 bytes, else InvalidBlock exception is raised.
properties.natural_language: Deposit event data must be exactly 576 bytes; any other length causes immediate block rejection.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: HIGH - Validates deposit data structure from blocks received via UNTRUSTED peers (relayed through SEMI_TRUSTED EL-CL interface).
properties.security_impact_if_violated: MEDIUM - Malformed deposits could cause parser confusion or memory corruption if not rejected early.

properties.formal_statement: For all deposit data, the ABI encoding must have: pubkey_offset=160, pubkey_size=48, withdrawal_creds_offset=256, withdrawal_creds_size=32, amount_offset=320, amount_size=8, signature_offset=384, signature_size=96, index_offset=512, index_size=8, else InvalidBlock.
properties.natural_language: All deposit field offsets and sizes must match exact ABI encoding specification; any deviation invalidates the block.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Comprehensive validation of deposit structure from UNTRUSTED block proposers.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: HIGH - Invalid offsets could cause field misalignment, extracting wrong data or enabling deposit fraud.

properties.formal_statement: For all requests collections, the final requests_hash = SHA256(concatenate(SHA256(request_1), SHA256(request_2), ...)) must be computed and included in the block header, binding block to its requests.
properties.natural_language: Block headers must commit to all requests (deposits, withdrawals, consolidations) via a cryptographic hash chain.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Creates binding commitment that block validators can verify against blocks from UNTRUSTED proposers.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Blocks could include different requests than committed to, enabling deposit/withdrawal fraud.

properties.formal_statement: For all requests, the first byte (type prefix) must be checked via ACTION-CHECK-REQUEST-TYPE and routed correctly: 0x00->Deposit, 0x01->Withdrawal, 0x02->Consolidation. Invalid types are rejected.
properties.natural_language: Request type byte must be valid (0x00, 0x01, or 0x02) and correctly route to appropriate consensus layer handler.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: MEDIUM - Validates request structure from blocks via UNTRUSTED proposers.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: MEDIUM - Misrouted requests could cause processing errors or bypass type-specific validation logic.

properties.formal_statement: For all MCOPY operations, the total gas cost = 3 (base) + 3 * ceil(length / 32) (copy cost) + memory_expansion_cost must be calculated and deducted before execution, else STATE-OUT-OF-GAS.
properties.natural_language: MCOPY opcode must charge correct gas (base + per-word + expansion) before copying memory; insufficient gas causes out-of-gas exception.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Prevents DoS from UNTRUSTED user transactions via JSON-RPC.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Underpriced MCOPY enables resource exhaustion attacks against nodes.

properties.formal_statement: For all MCOPY operations accessing memory[src:src+length] or memory[dst:dst+length], if max(src+length, dst+length) > current_memory_size, then ACTION-EXPAND-MEMORY must extend memory with zero bytes and charge quadratic expansion cost.
properties.natural_language: MCOPY must expand memory with zeros if source or destination exceeds current memory bounds, charging quadratic expansion cost.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: HIGH - Defends against memory attacks from UNTRUSTED contract bytecode.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: HIGH - Could enable memory DoS if expansion not charged, or memory corruption if not zero-filled.

properties.formal_statement: For all MCOPY operations where source [src, src+length) and destination [dst, dst+length) overlap, ACTION-COPY-AS-IF-BUFFERED must produce the same result as if an intermediate buffer were used, preventing data corruption.
properties.natural_language: MCOPY with overlapping memory regions must behave as if using an intermediate buffer to preserve semantic correctness.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: MEDIUM - Ensures correct behavior for contracts from UNTRUSTED sources.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: MEDIUM - Overlap mishandling could enable contracts to corrupt their own state in unexpected ways.

properties.formal_statement: The MCOPY gas formula: base(3) + copy(3 * words) + expansion(quadratic) must accurately reflect computational cost, preventing gas underpricing attacks.
properties.natural_language: MCOPY gas cost must accurately model computational resources to prevent economic DoS attacks.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Economic defense against UNTRUSTED user transactions attempting resource exhaustion.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Underpriced operations enable attackers to exhaust node resources cheaply.

properties.formal_statement: For all LightClientHeaders h, if epoch(h.beacon.slot) < CAPELLA_FORK_EPOCH, then ACTION-VALIDATE-PRE-CAPELLA must verify h.execution is empty/default; if >= CAPELLA_FORK_EPOCH, ACTION-VALIDATE-EXECUTION-BRANCH must verify the execution payload Merkle branch with EXECUTION_PAYLOAD_GINDEX=25.
properties.natural_language: Light client headers must have appropriate validation based on fork epoch: pre-Capella headers require empty execution fields, post-Capella require valid execution payload Merkle proofs.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Validates headers from UNTRUSTED full nodes with fork-specific rules.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Pre-Capella headers with execution data or post-Capella headers without valid proofs could bypass validation.

properties.formal_statement: For ACTION-VERIFY-BOOTSTRAP, the current_sync_committee Merkle branch must validate against bootstrap.header.state_root, binding the sync committee to the trusted checkpoint.
properties.natural_language: Light client bootstrap must cryptographically verify the sync committee against the checkpoint state root before accepting it.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Validates bootstrap data from UNTRUSTED servers against the out-of-band trusted root.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Light client could bootstrap with incorrect sync committee, accepting forged updates thereafter.
attack_scenarios_mitigated: Fake sync committee injection during bootstrap

properties.formal_statement: For all untrusted updates from EXT-UNTRUSTED-SERVER, the verification sequence ACTION-VERIFY-SYNC-COMMITTEE-SIG -> ACTION-VERIFY-FINALITY-PROOF -> ACTION-VERIFY-EXECUTION-PROOF must all succeed before reaching STATE-UPDATE-TRUSTED.
properties.natural_language: Untrusted light client updates must pass all three verification layers (sync committee signatures, finality proof, execution proof) before being trusted.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Comprehensive defense-in-depth against UNTRUSTED light client servers.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Skipping any verification layer could allow forged finality or execution data.

properties.formal_statement: For the fork transition at epoch=EIP6800_FORK_EPOCH, ACTION-UPGRADE-STATE must execute atomically at the first slot, copying all Deneb fields, updating fork.current_version to 0x05000000, and initializing execution_witness_root to hash_tree_root(ExecutionWitness([], [])).
properties.natural_language: EIP-6800 fork upgrade must happen atomically at the fork epoch boundary, preserving all state while initializing witness tracking.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - All nodes (including ones receiving blocks from UNTRUSTED peers) must perform identical upgrade.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Divergent fork upgrades cause permanent chain split between nodes.

properties.formal_statement: For all fork transitions, ACTION-VALIDATE-FORK-VERSION must verify fork.previous_version equals Deneb version and fork.current_version equals 0x05000000, and ACTION-VALIDATE-STATE-CONTINUITY must ensure all pre-fork fields are preserved unchanged.
properties.natural_language: Fork validation must confirm correct version progression and complete preservation of all existing beacon state fields.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: HIGH - Validates fork transition of blocks received from UNTRUSTED proposers.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: HIGH - Incorrect version or lost state fields could corrupt consensus or enable fork attacks.

properties.formal_statement: ACTION-INIT-EMPTY-WITNESS-ROOT must set execution_witness_root = hash_tree_root(ExecutionWitness(stems=[], suffix_diffs=[])), establishing the correct empty witness baseline for subsequent stateless validation.
properties.natural_language: Execution witness tracking must initialize with the correct empty witness root to enable future stateless validation.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Establishes the foundation for verifying execution witnesses in blocks from UNTRUSTED proposers.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Wrong empty witness root would cause immediate validation failures for all post-fork blocks.

properties.formal_statement: For all accounts touched in transaction execution (via EXT-TRANSACTION-EXECUTION), if ACTION-CHECK-ACCOUNT-EMPTY determines balance=0 AND nonce=0 AND code=empty, then ACTION-DELETE-EMPTY-ACCOUNT must remove the account from the state trie.
properties.natural_language: Empty accounts (zero balance, zero nonce, no code) touched during transaction execution must be deleted from the state trie.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: MEDIUM - Applies to account state modified by transactions from UNTRUSTED users.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: MEDIUM - State bloat accumulation, enabling long-term DoS via cheap account creation.

properties.formal_statement: For all contract creations (CREATE/CREATE2 from EXT-EVM-CREATE), after ACTION-EXECUTE-INIT-CODE produces runtime bytecode, ACTION-CHECK-CODE-SIZE must verify len(runtime_code) <= 24576 bytes, else ACTION-REVERT-CREATION.
properties.natural_language: Contract deployment must fail if runtime bytecode exceeds 24KB limit (24576 bytes).
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: HIGH - Limits contract size from UNTRUSTED deployers to prevent large contract DoS.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: HIGH - Unbounded contract sizes enable storage DoS and slow down contract loading.

properties.formal_statement: When ACTION-REVERT-CREATION executes due to code size exceeding 24KB, all gas provided to the CREATE operation must be consumed, preventing partial gas refunds for oversized contracts.
properties.natural_language: Contract creation failures due to size limit must consume all provided gas, not refund any.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: MEDIUM - Economic penalty for UNTRUSTED users attempting to deploy oversized contracts.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: LOW - Partial refunds could encourage repeated oversized deployment attempts.

properties.formal_statement: For all EXP opcodes (0x0a) from EXT-EVM-INTERPRETER, ACTION-COMPUTE-GAS-COST must calculate gas = 10 + 50 * byte_size_of_exponent (increased from 10 + 10 * byte_size pre-Spurious Dragon), preventing underpriced exponentiation DoS.
properties.natural_language: EXP opcode gas cost must be 10 + 50*exponent_bytes (5x increase from pre-fork) to prevent exponentiation DoS attacks.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Defends against computational DoS from UNTRUSTED contracts using EXP.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Underpriced EXP enables cheap computational DoS attacks.

properties.formal_statement: For all execution payloads from EXT-BLOCK-PROPOSER containing execution_witness, the verification sequence must be: ACTION-VALIDATE-PARENT-HASH -> ACTION-VALIDATE-RANDAO -> ACTION-VALIDATE-TIMESTAMP -> ACTION-VALIDATE-BLOB-COMMITMENTS -> ACTION-VERIFY-PAYLOAD-ENGINE (including Verkle proof verification) before STATE-PAYLOAD-VALIDATED.
properties.natural_language: Execution payloads with Verkle witnesses must pass all validation checks (parent hash, RANDAO, timestamp, blobs, AND Verkle proof verification via execution engine) before acceptance.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Multi-layer validation of payloads from UNTRUSTED block proposers.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Invalid payloads or forged Verkle proofs could corrupt state or enable theft.

properties.formal_statement: For all state transitions, ACTION-VERIFY-VERKLE-PROOF must cryptographically verify the VerkleProof (IPA proof with commitments_by_path) against the state_diff before ACTION-APPLY-STATE-DIFF modifies world state.
properties.natural_language: Verkle proofs must be cryptographically verified before applying any state diffs to ensure state changes are legitimate.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Verifies state diffs from UNTRUSTED proposers via SEMI_TRUSTED execution engine.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Invalid state diffs could enable arbitrary state modifications, theft, or consensus corruption.

properties.formal_statement: For all witness data from EXT-NETWORK-PEER, ACTION-VALIDATE-WITNESS-STRUCTURE must verify constraints: len(stems) <= MAX_STEMS (65536), all suffix indices < VERKLE_WIDTH (256), depth <= IPA_PROOF_DEPTH, commitments_per_stem <= MAX_COMMITMENTS_PER_STEM (33) before ACTION-VERIFY-IPA-PROOF.
properties.natural_language: Verkle witness structure must satisfy all container size constraints before cryptographic verification to prevent DoS via oversized data.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - First line of defense against malformed witnesses from UNTRUSTED network peers.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: HIGH - Oversized witnesses could cause memory exhaustion or processing DoS before cryptographic verification.

properties.formal_statement: For all Verkle witnesses, ACTION-VERIFY-IPA-PROOF must cryptographically verify the inner product argument (cl, cr vectors, final_evaluation) against the commitment before STATE-WITNESS-TRUSTED.
properties.natural_language: Inner Product Argument (IPA) proofs must be cryptographically verified to ensure Verkle tree commitments are valid.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Core cryptographic defense against forged Verkle proofs from UNTRUSTED sources.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Forged IPA proofs enable accepting arbitrary invalid state transitions.

properties.formal_statement: For all blocks where block.number >= MUIR_GLACIER_FORK_BLKNUM, ACTION-COMPUTE-FAKE-BLOCK-NUMBER must calculate fake_block_number = max(0, block.number - 9000000) for use in difficulty calculation, delaying the bomb by ~611 days.
properties.natural_language: Post-Muir Glacier blocks must use fake_block_number (actual - 9M) for difficulty calculation to delay the difficulty bomb.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: HIGH - All nodes must compute identical difficulty for blocks from UNTRUSTED miners.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Inconsistent difficulty calculations cause permanent chain splits.

properties.formal_statement: For all blocks from EXT-BLOCK-PRODUCER-POW, ACTION-COMPUTE-EXPECTED-DIFFICULTY must independently recalculate expected difficulty using parent difficulty, parent timestamp, and fork-adjusted block number, then ACTION-COMPARE-DIFFICULTY must reject blocks where stated_difficulty != expected_difficulty.
properties.natural_language: Block difficulty claims from miners must be independently recalculated and verified; mismatches cause block rejection.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Validates difficulty claims from UNTRUSTED PoW miners.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Miners could submit low-difficulty blocks, enabling easier chain reorgs or 51% attacks.

properties.formal_statement: After ACTION-APPLY-MUIR-GLACIER-DELAY reduces the effective block number by 9M, the network must transition from STATE-DIFFICULTY-BOMB-STARTING back to STATE-NORMAL-BLOCK-TIME with ~13 second block intervals restored.
properties.natural_language: Muir Glacier difficulty bomb delay must restore normal ~13 second block times by resetting the bomb timer.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Network-wide liveness depends on all nodes applying the delay uniformly.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL (Liveness) - Network would slow to a halt as difficulty bomb makes mining impractical.

properties.formal_statement: For transactions from STATE-USER-ZERO-BALANCE accounts via EXT-USER-JSON-RPC, the proposer (via EXT-BLOCK-PROPOSER) must execute ACTION-PROPOSER-CREATE-ETHER-SEND to temporarily fund the account before ACTION-EXECUTE-USER-TXS, ensuring gas fees can be paid.
properties.natural_language: Block proposers must temporarily fund zero-balance accounts with Ether before executing their transactions to cover gas costs.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: HIGH - Proposers handle transactions from UNTRUSTED zero-balance users via JSON-RPC.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: MEDIUM - Zero-balance transactions would fail due to insufficient gas funds.
attack_scenarios_mitigated: Transaction execution failure due to zero balance

properties.formal_statement: For all no-ether transaction evaluations, the proposer must execute ACTION-SIMULATE-FIRST-RUN, then ACTION-ROLLBACK-REEXECUTE with actual gas costs, then ACTION-VERIFY-CONSIDERATION-MATCH to ensure consideration is consistent across both runs, else abort.
properties.natural_language: Proposers must simulate transaction execution twice with consideration consistency verification to prevent manipulation attacks.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Prevents manipulation by UNTRUSTED users submitting adversarial transaction batches.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: HIGH - Users could manipulate gas estimates to extract consideration without paying proposers fairly.

properties.formal_statement: ACTION-APPLY-BUSINESS-LOGIC must evaluate whether consideration_value >= gas_cost_in_ether * profitability_threshold, transitioning to STATE-EVALUATION-FAVORABLE only if economically viable for the proposer.
properties.natural_language: Proposers must only accept zero-balance transactions where the consideration value meets or exceeds gas costs plus profitability margin.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: HIGH - Economic defense against unprofitable transactions from UNTRUSTED users.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: MEDIUM - Proposers lose money executing unprofitable transactions, enabling economic griefing.

properties.formal_statement: For tokens transferred to the free-for-all bucket (STATE-FAA-CONTRACT-DEPLOYED), only the block proposer can extract them via ACTION-EXECUTE-WITHDRAWAL during block construction, preventing front-running or theft by other actors.
properties.natural_language: Only the current block proposer can extract consideration tokens from the free-for-all bucket during their block construction window.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Protects consideration from UNTRUSTED third parties attempting theft.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Anyone could steal consideration tokens, destroying the economic model.

properties.formal_statement: The free-for-all bucket contract must implement access control such that execute() can only be called by authorized block proposers during their block construction context, not by arbitrary external callers.
properties.natural_language: Free-for-all bucket execute() function must be restricted to authorized proposers, preventing unauthorized token extraction.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Access control against UNTRUSTED callers attempting unauthorized extraction.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Unauthorized parties could drain all consideration tokens.

properties.formal_statement: For all validators, ACTION-COMPUTE-CUSTODY-REQUIREMENT must calculate custody_groups = clamp(total_balance // 32_ETH, VALIDATOR_CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT (8), NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS), ensuring minimum data availability participation.
properties.natural_language: Validators must custody a number of column groups proportional to their stake, with a minimum of 8 groups, ensuring network-wide data availability.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: HIGH - Ensures all validators contribute to data availability, defending against data withholding from UNTRUSTED peers.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: HIGH - Insufficient custody coverage could enable data withholding attacks.

properties.formal_statement: For all validators, ACTION-ADVERTISE-CUSTODY must accurately update the node's ENR with the current custody_group_count, allowing peers to discover custody capabilities without relying on UNTRUSTED claims.
properties.natural_language: Validators must advertise their custody group count in ENR records, enabling peer discovery of data availability capabilities.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: MEDIUM - ENR data can be verified through sampling, but initial discovery relies on potentially UNTRUSTED advertisements.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: MEDIUM - Inaccurate ENR data could cause peers to request columns from wrong nodes, degrading data availability.

properties.formal_statement: For payloads from EXT-EXECUTION-ENGINE via engine_getPayloadV5, ACTION-CONSTRUCT-COLUMN-SIDECARS must create sidecars via get_data_column_sidecars() from cell proofs, where each sidecar represents a vertical column slice across all blobs, maintaining KZG commitment consistency.
properties.natural_language: Data column sidecars must be correctly constructed from cell-based blob proofs, preserving KZG commitment bindings.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: HIGH - Relies on cell proofs from SEMI_TRUSTED execution engine; incorrect construction could propagate invalid data.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: HIGH - Invalid sidecars would fail KZG verification, preventing block acceptance.

properties.formal_statement: For all constructed sidecars, ACTION-PUBLISH-TO-SUBNETS must publish each sidecar to its designated data_column_sidecar_{subnet_id} pubsub topic, ensuring proper distribution across the P2P network.
properties.natural_language: Column sidecars must be published to correct subnet topics for peer retrieval and data availability verification.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: MEDIUM - Distribution to UNTRUSTED peers; recipients will verify KZG proofs independently.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: MEDIUM - Incorrect subnet routing prevents peers from finding data, degrading data availability.

properties.formal_statement: For all column sidecars, ACTION-CHECK-RETENTION-PERIOD must determine if age < MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS, transitioning to STATE-WITHIN-RETENTION where serving to peers is mandatory, else STATE-BEYOND-RETENTION where pruning is permitted.
properties.natural_language: Column sidecars within retention window must be served to peers; older sidecars may be pruned.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: MEDIUM - Ensures data availability for UNTRUSTED peers requesting recent data.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: MEDIUM - Premature pruning could prevent data availability verification, degrading security guarantees.

properties.formal_statement: ACTION-PRUNE-SIDECAR must only execute when STATE-BEYOND-RETENTION is reached (age >= MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS), never for in-retention-window sidecars.
properties.natural_language: Sidecar pruning is only permitted after the retention window expires, never before.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: MEDIUM - Ensures validators don't prematurely discard data needed for peer verification.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: MEDIUM - Early pruning could violate data availability guarantees.

properties.formal_statement: For all data received from UNTRUSTED external entities (EXT-FULL-NODE-P2P, EXT-UNTRUSTED-LC-SERVER, EXT-NETWORK-PEER-P2P, EXT-BLOCK-PROPOSER-CL, EXT-BLOCK-PRODUCER-POW, EXT-USER-JSON-RPC, EXT-P2P-PEERS-DAS, EXT-MALICIOUS-VALIDATOR, EXT-MEV-RELAY), independent cryptographic verification or validation MUST occur before the data affects consensus-critical state.
properties.natural_language: All data crossing the trust boundary from untrusted sources must be independently validated before use in consensus.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Core security principle enforcing defense-in-depth against all UNTRUSTED sources.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Trust boundary violations enable complete system compromise.

properties.formal_statement: For data received from SEMI_TRUSTED sources (EXT-CL-VIA-ENGINE-API, EXT-EXECUTION-ENGINE), the authenticated channel (JWT) provides identity verification, but content MUST still be validated: EL must validate execution payloads from CL, and CL must verify execution results though CL cannot independently re-verify state transitions.
properties.natural_language: SEMI_TRUSTED interfaces (Engine API) require authentication AND content validation, though some verifications are trusted.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Defines trust model for CL-EL interface; compromise of either layer compromises both.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - EL-CL desync could enable consensus fraud or state corruption.

properties.formal_statement: For a light client to securely track the beacon chain, it must: (1) obtain a correct trusted block root via EXT-USER-TRUST-SOURCE, (2) verify bootstrap sync committee via Merkle proof, (3) validate all updates with BLS signatures + Merkle proofs + slot ordering + period constraints + participation thresholds, (4) apply is_better_update ranking, (5) enforce safety thresholds (50% for optimistic, 2/3 for finality), (6) handle UPDATE_TIMEOUT with force updates. Any failure in this chain breaks security.
properties.natural_language: Light client security requires the entire validation pipeline from trusted bootstrap through all cryptographic checks to safety thresholds; breaking any link compromises the system.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Comprehensive defense against UNTRUSTED full nodes attempting to compromise light clients.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Light client accepts fraudulent chain state, enabling theft or censorship for light client users.

properties.formal_statement: For deposits to securely join the validator set, the pipeline must: (1) filter logs from canonical deposit contract only, (2) validate exact 576-byte length, (3) validate all field offsets and sizes, (4) extract deposit fields correctly, (5) hash individual requests, (6) chain hashes for block commitment, (7) route by type prefix. Any bypass enables fake deposits.
properties.natural_language: Deposit security requires complete validation pipeline from contract filtering through hashing; any gap allows validator set pollution.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Multi-layer defense against deposit fraud from UNTRUSTED block proposers.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Fake deposits enable unauthorized validators to join, corrupting consensus.

properties.formal_statement: For Verkle-based stateless validation, the security chain requires: (1) fork activation at correct epoch with empty witness init, (2) witness structure validation (size limits), (3) IPA proof cryptographic verification, (4) Verkle proof verification against state diff, (5) execution engine verification via Engine API, (6) execution_witness_root commitment in payload header. Breaking any link enables state fraud.
properties.natural_language: Verkle witness security requires complete verification from structure validation through cryptographic proofs to execution engine verification; any gap allows state corruption.
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Enables stateless validation against UNTRUSTED block proposers with Verkle witnesses.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: CRITICAL - Invalid state transitions could enable theft, double-spends, or consensus corruption.

properties.formal_statement: For network-wide data availability in Fulu, the system requires: (1) custody requirement calculation based on validator balance, (2) ENR advertisement of custody capabilities, (3) column download and storage, (4) cell-based sidecar construction from engine_getPayloadV5, (5) subnet distribution, (6) retention window enforcement. Any failure degrades data availability guarantees.
properties.natural_language: Data availability requires the full pipeline from custody calculation through sidecar distribution to retention enforcement; any gap enables data withholding.
affected_edge_ids: All Fulu validator custody and blob handling edges
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Ensures data availability against UNTRUSTED peers withholding data.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: HIGH - Data withholding could prevent block validation, enabling censorship or availability attacks.

properties.formal_statement: For no-ether transactions to be secure, the protocol requires: (1) user signs ordered transaction batch, (2) proposer creates temporary Ether funding, (3) double-execution simulation with consistency verification, (4) economic profitability validation, (5) free-for-all bucket access control, (6) consideration extraction only by authorized proposer. Any weakness enables griefing or theft.
properties.natural_language: Zero-balance transaction security requires complete evaluation pipeline from signature through double-execution to access-controlled extraction; any gap enables economic attacks.
affected_edge_ids: All EIP-7768 transaction lifecycle and free-for-all edges
properties.trust_boundary_relevance: CRITICAL - Enables zero-balance accounts from UNTRUSTED users while protecting proposer economics.
properties.security_impact_if_violated: HIGH - Proposer griefing, consideration theft, or system manipulation.

coverage_summary.coverage_notes: All nodes and edges from all unique subgraphs are covered by at least one security property. Properties include granular validations for individual components plus comprehensive end-to-end properties covering complete security chains. Cross-boundary properties enforce trust model across all external entity interactions.
